text:
morgan: Serious question — is semver just emotional support for YAML? 🤔
stacey: 100%. Patch bumps are the group therapy of infra. 'I fixed a typo' -> +0.0.1 :joy:
alex: Honestly I think YAML whispers to semver: `version: '1.2.3'` then asks for a hug.
jules: deploy-bot blocked my PR this morning cause I wrote `version: 1.2` and it called it "incomplete feelings". :cry:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ❗ Check failed: invalid semver "1.2". Please use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
ryan: Can we have a support group? Lunch meeting: "Semver Anonymous" — sandwiches provided. :sandwich:
stacey: I'll bring cookies and a sticker that says "I survived a merge conflict" :cookie:
alex: Also the YAML romance language is peak 2026:```yaml
service:
  name: shipping
  version: 'v1..3'
```stacey: That `v1..3` is the ellipsis of commitment issues.
morgan: Poll: taco (:taco:), sandwich (:sandwich:), or ramen (:ramen:)? react with emoji — results will settle who gets to write the release notes. :grin:
